title: Day 29: Lease-Backs, Flexible Closing & Seller-Friendly Terms
excerpt: Sellers who need time after closing (new construction delays, school calendars, or job transitions) can request a short lease-back or flexible closing.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “seller lease back Austin”, “flexible closing date real estate Texas”, and “post closing occupancy agreement” want a local, practical answer.

Sellers who need time after closing (new construction delays, school calendars, or job transitions) can request a short lease-back or flexible closing. These terms can make an otherwise average offer more attractive.

Document everything clearly; insurance and deposit arrangements matter.

Buyers who can accommodate reasonable post-closing occupancy often gain an edge without increasing price.
